comments: during the 1st restore, BR tried to stop the PD scheduler, however, it is meaningless since PD is not bootstrapped. we already test the issue, and it never happen.

review_comments: why add another layer of retry on top of GetAllTiKVStoresWithRetry

the inner function has retry only 500 ms, it is enough for BR other restore, but here for EBS, 2nd restore may failure since pd + tikv startup take longer than 500 ms, to separate from BR legacy restore, add XX Ext retry.
maybe add a unit test for this function.
